title: OL-ROLE-community-manager: activate the community manager role (phase 2)
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** phase 2 gate passes (python3 -m foundation team --gate)
**Done check:** file:agents/roles/community-manager.md
**Status:** open

Activate the community manager role: python3 -m foundation team --apply writes the role files, the seed role and the loop entry once the gate is open. Metric: external_contributors_30d.
